en: Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible and impinging, a phenomenon that is visible and impinging arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible and impinging, a phenomenon that is invisible but impinging arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible and impinging, a phenomenon that is invisible and non-impinging arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible and impinging, there arise phenomena that are both visible and impinging and invisible and non-impinging by way of root condition.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible and impinging, there arise phenomena that are invisible and impinging and invisible and non-impinging by way of root condition. [Dependent on] a phenomenon that is non-visible and impinging...
Dependent on a state that is both visible and impinging, states that are both visible and impinging and invisible but impinging arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not visible but impinging, states that are both visible and impinging, invisible but impinging, and invisible and non-impinging arise by way of root condition... [seven].
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible and non-reacting, a phenomenon that is non-visible and reacting arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible and non-reacting, a phenomenon that is visible and reacting arises by way of root condition … seven.
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible and non-reacting, a phenomenon that is non-visible and non-reacting arises by way of root condition … seven. (Abbreviated.)

With respect to the root condition, there are thirty-five; with respect to the object condition, three ... pe ... with respect to the mutuality condition, ten ... pe ... with respect to the non-disappearance condition, thirty-five.
(The section on questions should also be expanded in detail.)
